## Desktop

### Improvements

## Core

### Bugfixes
- Sessions with many images no longer send oversized requests. When the images in a session's history pass 25 MiB, the oldest are replaced with a placeholder.
- A provider error for a request body that is too large now starts compaction and a retry instead of failing the turn.

### New Features

- **[Terminal session resume](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.7.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/terminal-setup.md#program-resume):** Compatible terminals can reopen the current pi session after a restart with its original profile, tool restrictions, and instructions.
- **[Image generation in codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.7.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#generate-images):** Generate images with Radius, or set the aspect ratio and size when using OpenRouter image models.
- **GitHub Copilot prompt caching:** Changing the thinking level preserves the prompt cache on supported Claude 5.x and GPT-6 models. Supported Claude 5.x models also keep the cache when tools change, and Copilot Claude models support [cache warming](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.7.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#model-and-thinking).

- Removed telemetry reporting from pi for new installs and updates (`/api/report-install`), the `enableInstallTelemetry` setting (`SettingsManager.getEnableInstallTelemetry()` / `setEnableInstallTelemetry()`), and `PI_TELEMETRY`

### Added

- Added program resume through the [Program Resume Protocol (OSC 7577)](https://www.superlogical.com/rex/docs/build/program-resume): in terminals that set `OSC7577_TOKEN`, interactive mode reports `pi --session <id>` for the current session, so the terminal can bring it back after it restarts. Pi removes the token from the environment of every process it starts. See [Terminal setup](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.7.0/pack

Hey all, hope all americans are having a great Thanksgiving! 🦃 

## Onboarding

We plan to work on the onboarding to help new Crush users. On this release we're shipping a first pass:

* Before, we skipped the onboarding if any API were found on your ENV. Now we'll always show for new installations.
* ENVs keep working as expected. If one was found for the chosen provider, Crush will just use it and won't ask you to paste an API key.
* UI was enhanced the make it better use the space. List is taller and you can see more items at once.
* Better mouse support (see below)

You can use your mouse on the provider list dialog: scroll and select with click or choose with double-click.

Because this is a shared component between the models dialog and onboarding, this improvement is available in both scenarios.

Since 0.2.0 most of the agent code has moved from Python to Rust. Rust is now the largest language in the repository (about 45%, up from 23% in 0.2.0). ## Security fix

With the ReAct runner (`runner: react`), `ReactConverter` fell back to Python `eval()` on the model's `Action:` text whenever it was not valid JSON. A prompt-injected action (from a web page, tool result or document the agent reads) could execute arbitrary Python on the host. Actions are now parsed with `ast.literal_eval` and must be a dict with `name` and `arguments`. Reported through TSRC.

The default `openai` runner is not affected. Upgrade if you use the ReAct runner.
